robert-gonzales.text: As an Azusa councilmember in January 2026, Gonzales voted yes (4-0, one abstention) to certify the EIR, amend the General Plan and rezone parts of the Azusa Greens golf course to medium-density residential and light industrial, with a development agreement.

source.title: City of Azusa City Council minutes, Jan. 20, 2026

notes: Robert Gonzales is an Azusa councilmember (not on the current SGVMWD board roster). Azusa minutes reviewed (Jan.–May 2026) show no dissenting votes by him; the July 2026 Azusa water-rate hearing minutes weren't yet posted.
